notes.title: Added New Systems to DEEMO -Reborn- STEAM Version
notes.notes:
Added New Systems to DEEMO -Reborn- STEAM Version
STEAM Page: http://short.rayark.com/DRsteam

https://youtu.be/VNYtwKHp6Gg

During a song, pressing Settings on the bottom right corner will allow you to choose "Random Chart" and "Autoplay".

The scores accumulated during Autoplay will still make the tree grow, allowing players to explore new areas!

The Random Chart mode is always different, with every note's placement completely random, giving players a new way to test their reflexes!

※ Keymapping for rhythm sections will be added in the next update.
※ To report any gameplay issues please send an email to service@rayark.com.

notes.title: On 9/4 DEEMO -Reborn- will be Launched on STEAM!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38059420/0546f698efda5494f58ad920c897c6d8bd266dbc.png[/img]

On 9/4 DEEMO -Reborn- will be Launched on STEAM!
STEAM Page: http://short.rayark.com/DRsteam
Add it to your wish list now, so you won't miss the latest news!

"The answer to all the questions, shall be Reborn through the sound of the piano."

Features:
-A Classic Reborn: Centered around an ancient castle and a mysterious tree that grows when melody is in the air, control the little girl who has fallen from the sky and help her find her way home.

-Investigation Reborn: Unravel riddles and mysteries hidden in the castle. Find sheet music that falls from the heavens, unlock new places, and discover the truth.

-Rhythm Reborn: Play your heart out on the piano and make the mysterious tree grow. Unveil new parts of the story and look forward to the day that the girl can return to her heart-warming home.

-Melodies Reborn: Over 60+ classic songs that are loved by all. New pieces of music await you to take on their challenge.
